decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2071.01, 2071.03, unnumbered design and access statement received 05/02/2013, 2071.04a, received 26/02/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No additional mechanical plant units shall be installed without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The sound power level of the proposed mechanical plant units shall be equal to or less than the sound power level of the existing mechanical plant on site unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: The installation of mechanical plant at the rear/ side of the property.
